source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 20 (book page 273); the book prints no answers for Exercise 9.2; answers checked with sympy and the solution book

blocks.explanation:
Pehli nazar mein yeh sawal mushkil lagta hai, lekin teeno terms ko ghaur se dekhiye: teeno woh double-angle shaklein hain jo hum isi exercise mein pehle mil chuke hain.
Diya kya hai? Ek equation jis mein \(p\), \(q\) aur \(y\) hain. Dikhana kya hai? \(y = \frac{p + q}{1 - pq}\).
Rule kaunsa? Question 12, Question 14 (i), aur kitab ka formula \(2\tan^{-1} x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1 - x^2}\); phir formula (v).
Plan: teeno terms ko \(2\tan^{-1}\) banana, 2 se divide karna, formula (v) se jorna, aur tan lena.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin^{-1}\frac{2p}{1 + p^2} + \cos^{-1}\frac{1 - q^2}{1 + q^2} = \tan^{-1}\frac{2y}{1 - y^2}\).
Dikhana hai: \(y = \frac{p + q}{1 - pq}\).
Tareeqa: Teeno double-angle shaklein pehchan kar equation ko \(\tan^{-1} p\), \(\tan^{-1} q\) aur \(\tan^{-1} y\) ki equation bana denge. Kitab ki tarah hum woh values lete hain jahan yeh results sahi hain: \(-1 \le p \le 1\), \(q \ge 0\), \(-1 < y < 1\) aur \(pq < 1\).

Har term ko badlein
\[\sin^{-1}\dfrac{2p}{1 + p^2} = 2\tan^{-1} p\]
\[\cos^{-1}\dfrac{1 - q^2}{1 + q^2} = 2\tan^{-1} q\]
\[\tan^{-1}\dfrac{2y}{1 - y^2} = 2\tan^{-1} y\]
Kyun: Pehli line Question 12 hai (\(-1 \le p \le 1\) par), doosri Question 14 (i) (\(q \ge 0\) par), aur teesri kitab ka Section 9.2 wala result \(2\tan^{-1} x = \tan^{-1}\frac{2x}{1 - x^2}\) (\(-1 < y < 1\) par). Yani pichhle sawal yahan auzaar (tools) ban kar kaam aa rahe hain.

Rakh kar 2 se divide karein
\[2\tan^{-1} p + 2\tan^{-1} q = 2\tan^{-1} y\]
\[\tan^{-1} p + \tan^{-1} q = \tan^{-1} y\]
Kyun: Har term mein 2 ka factor hai, is liye poori equation ko 2 se divide kar diya.

Formula (v) se jorein
\[\tan^{-1}\dfrac{p + q}{1 - pq} = \tan^{-1} y\]
Kyun: Formula (v) do \(\tan^{-1}\) ko ek bana deta hai, aur \(pq < 1\) ki wajah se bilkul sahi hai.

Dono taraf tan lein
\[y = \dfrac{p + q}{1 - pq}\]
Kyun: \(\tan(\tan^{-1} u) = u\) har real \(u\) ke liye sahi hai, is liye dono \(\tan^{-1}\) hat gaye.
Dhyan dein: Ulta qadam, yani \(\tan^{-1}\) ko "cancel" karna, tabhi theek hai jab dono taraf poora \(\tan^{-1}\) ho; bas andar wali cheezein barabar likh dein.

Tasdeeq
\[p = 0.3,\ q = 0.4:\ y = \dfrac{0.7}{0.88} \approx 0.7955\]
\[\sin^{-1}\dfrac{0.6}{1.09} \approx 0.5829\]
\[\cos^{-1}\dfrac{0.84}{1.16} \approx 0.7610\]
\[\text{sum} \approx 0.5829 + 0.7610\]
\[= 1.3439\]
\[\tan^{-1}\dfrac{2y}{1 - y^2} \approx \tan^{-1} 4.3319 \approx 1.3439\]
Kyun: Choti si misaal li: \(p = 0.3\), \(q = 0.4\). Formula se \(y \approx 0.7955\) aaya, aur asal equation ki dono sides calculator par 1.3439 aayin. Is liye natija sahi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 9.2 ke jawab chhape hue nahi hain. Is page ka har hal hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Is liye aap apna proof yahan wale proof se mila kar dekh sakte hain; agar aap ka tareeqa alag hai magar har qadam ki wajah sahi hai, to woh bhi theek hai.
